settings.name: USE_OPENIDC
settings.description: Enable or disable OpenID Connect authentication.

settings.name: OPENIDC_DISCOVERY
settings.description: OpenID Connect discovery URL (e.g. https://idp.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration).

settings.name: OPENIDC_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: OAuth 2.0 client identifier registered with the IdP.

settings.name: OPENIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret registered with the IdP.

settings.name: OPENIDC_TOKEN_ENDPOINT_AUTH_METHOD
settings.description: Token endpoint auth method: basic (recommended, HTTP Basic), post (POST body), secret_jwt (JWT with client secret), private_key_jwt (JWT with RSA key).

settings.name: OPENIDC_CLIENT_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY
settings.description: PEM-encoded RSA private key for private_key_jwt authentication.

settings.name: OPENIDC_CLIENT_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY_ID
settings.description: Optional key ID (kid) for private_key_jwt authentication.

settings.name: OPENIDC_CLIENT_JWT_ASSERTION_EXPIRES_IN
settings.description: JWT assertion lifetime in seconds (empty to use library default).

settings.name: OPENIDC_REDIRECT_URI
settings.description: URI path where the IdP redirects after authentication.

settings.name: OPENIDC_SCOPE
settings.description: Space-separated list of OAuth 2.0 scopes to request.

settings.name: OPENIDC_AUTHORIZATION_PARAMS
settings.description: Additional authorization params as comma-separated key=value pairs (e.g. audience=api,resource=xyz). URL-encode values if needed.

settings.name: OPENIDC_USE_NONCE
settings.description: Use nonce in authentication requests to prevent replay attacks.

settings.name: OPENIDC_USE_PKCE
settings.description: Use PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) for authorization code flow.

settings.name: OPENIDC_FORCE_REAUTHORIZE
settings.description: Force re-authorization on every request (not recommended for production).

settings.name: OPENIDC_REFRESH_SESSION_INTERVAL
settings.description: Interval in seconds to silently re-authenticate (empty to disable).

settings.name: OPENIDC_IAT_SLACK
settings.description: Allowed clock skew in seconds for token validation.

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN
settings.description: Default access token lifetime (seconds) if not provided by IdP.

settings.name: OPENIDC_RENEW_ACCESS_TOKEN_ON_EXPIRY
settings.description: Automatically renew access token using refresh token when expired.

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACCEPT_UNSUPPORTED_ALG
settings.description: Accept tokens signed with unsupported algorithms (not recommended).

settings.name: OPENIDC_LOGOUT_PATH
settings.description: URI path for logout requests.

settings.name: OPENIDC_REVOKE_TOKENS_ON_LOGOUT
settings.description: Revoke tokens at the IdP when logging out.

settings.name: OPENIDC_REDIRECT_AFTER_LOGOUT_URI
settings.description: URI to redirect after logout (leave empty for IdP default).

settings.name: OPENIDC_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI
settings.description: URI to redirect after IdP logout is complete.

settings.name: OPENIDC_TIMEOUT_CONNECT
settings.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds for IdP requests.

settings.name: OPENIDC_TIMEOUT_SEND
settings.description: Send timeout in milliseconds for IdP requests.

settings.name: OPENIDC_TIMEOUT_READ
settings.description: Read timeout in milliseconds for IdP requests.

settings.name: OPENIDC_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: Verify SSL certificates when communicating with the IdP.

settings.name: OPENIDC_KEEPALIVE
settings.description: Enable HTTP keepalive for connections to the IdP.

settings.name: OPENIDC_HTTP_PROXY
settings.description: HTTP proxy URL for IdP connections (e.g. http://proxy:8080).

settings.name: OPENIDC_HTTPS_PROXY
settings.description: HTTPS proxy URL for IdP connections (e.g. http://proxy:8080).

settings.name: OPENIDC_USER_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass user info to upstream (empty to disable).

settings.name: OPENIDC_USER_HEADER_CLAIM
settings.description: ID token claim to use for the user header (e.g. sub, email, preferred_username).

settings.name: OPENIDC_DISPLAY_CLAIM
settings.description: Claim to use for display in logs and metrics (e.g. preferred_username, name, email). Falls back to User Header Claim if not found.

settings.name: OPENIDC_EMAIL_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user email to upstream (empty to disable).

settings.name: OPENIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM
settings.description: ID token/userinfo claim used for the email header (e.g. email).

settings.name: OPENIDC_GROUPS_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user groups to upstream (empty to disable).

settings.name: OPENIDC_GROUPS_CLAIM
settings.description: ID token/userinfo claim used for the groups header (e.g. groups, roles).

settings.name: OPENIDC_GROUPS_SEPARATOR
settings.description: Separator used to join multiple group values in the groups header.

settings.name: OPENIDC_NAME_HEADER
settings.description: Header to pass the user display name to upstream (empty to disable).

settings.name: OPENIDC_NAME_CLAIM
settings.description: ID token/userinfo claim used for the display name header (e.g. name).

settings.name: OPENIDC_DISCOVERY_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Size of the shared dictionary to cache discovery data.

settings.name: OPENIDC_JWKS_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Size of the shared dictionary to cache JWKS data.

settings.name: OPENIDC_USE_ACL
settings.description: Enable claim-based access control (ACL) after OIDC authentication. When enabled, only users whose claims match the configured rules will be granted access.

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACL_MATCH_MODE
settings.description: How multiple ACL rules are evaluated. 'all' means every rule must pass (AND logic). 'any' means at least one rule must pass (OR logic).

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACL_DENIED_URL
settings.description: URL to redirect to when access is denied by ACL. If empty, returns a 403 Forbidden response.

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACL_CLAIM
settings.description: Name of the OIDC claim to check (e.g. groups, email, sub, preferred_username).

settings.name: OPENIDC_ACL_CLAIM_VALUE
settings.description: Expected value for the claim. For array claims (e.g. groups), checks if this value is a member. For string claims, checks strict equality.
